gaps.valueSet: Body temperature at least 38 C or 100.4 F
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no vital-sign measurement or unit-aware numeric comparison; rules 2-11 retain the coded fever diagnosis and active-problem alternatives

gaps.valueSet: Numeric CRP, platelet, lymphocyte, and antibody-result thresholds
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no unit-aware numeric laboratory comparison; rules 2-11 retain the source's same-observation abnormal-interpretation alternatives, while the antibody result-value greater-than-zero alternative is omitted

the authoritative source provides no codes for decreased ejection fraction, coronary dilatation, coronary ectasia, elevated troponin, conjunctival injection, hand/foot edema, and hand/foot erythema; their coded SNOMED alternatives remain modeled

gaps.valueSet: COVID-19 exposure within 60 days before hospitalization
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no relative exposure-timeframe predicate; rules 8-11 model the source's partially implemented coded exposure criterion without the timeframe
the authoritative source marks this reporter type unavailable in RCKMS; the death-certificate criterion is not modeled as a condition-pack rule
